title: Dasakam 41 — Pūtanādahanaṃ tathā Kṛṣṇalālanāhlādam
description: Nanda returns to Gokula after Vasudeva’s warning; Putana’s aftermath is witnessed; the community delights in Krishna’s childhood.

source.commentary: intake/D041/photo-captions.txt; provenance and mapping in content/sources/d041/

translation_note: No sourced English verse translation is included; translation_en is intentionally empty pending editorial review.

stanzas.sanskrit:
व्रजेश्वरः शौरिवचो निशम्य
समाव्रजन्नध्वनि भीतचेताः ।
निष्पिष्टनिश्शेषतरुं निरीक्ष्य
कञ्चित्पदार्थं शरणं गतस्त्वाम् ॥ ४१-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vrajeśvaraḥ śaurivaco niśamya
samāvajannadhvani bhītacetāḥ |
niṣpiṣṭaniśśeṣataruṃ nirīkṣya
kañcitpadārthaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatastvām || 41-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Nandagopan returned to Gokulam immediately as per the advice of Vasudeva. On his way, he saw a huge thing falling on the earth, crashing the trees. Frightened at this sight, Nandagopan surrendered to Bhagwan

stanzas.sanskrit:
निशम्य गोपीवचनादुदन्तं
सर्वेऽपि गोपा भयविस्मयान्धाः ।
त्वत्पातितं घोरपिशाचदेहं
देहुर्विदूरेऽथ कुठारकृत्तम् ॥ ४१-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
niśamya gopīvacanādudantaṃ
sarve’pi gopā bhayavismayāndhāḥ |
tvatpātitaṃ ghorapiśācadehaṃ
dehurvidūre’tha kuṭhārakṛttam || 41-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The gopas were spellbound and shocked when they were informed by the gopikas about the incident. They took axe and cut Putana's body in to pieces and cremated it at a distant place.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वत्पीतपूतस्तनतच्छरीरा-
-त्समुच्चलन्नुच्चतरो हि धूमः ।
शङ्कामधादागरवः किमेष
किं चान्दनो गौग्गुलवोऽथवेति ॥ ४१-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvatpītapūtastanataccharīrā-
-tsamuccalannuccataro hi dhūmaḥ |
śaṅkāmadhādāgaravaḥ kimeṣa
kiṃ cāndano gauggulavo’thaveti || 41-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan had sat on Putana's lap and sucked the breast milk, which purified her. So when fire engulfed her body, good fragrance produced from it, making everyone wonder if it was incense or sandalwood that is burning.

stanzas.sanskrit:
मदङ्गसङ्गस्य फलं न दूरे
क्षणेन तावद्भवतामपि स्यात् ।
इत्युल्लपन् वल्लवतल्लजेभ्य-
-स्त्वं पूतनामातनुथाः सुगन्धिम् ॥ ४१-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
madaṅgasaṅgasya phalaṃ na dūre
kṣaṇena tāvadbhavatāmapi syāt |
ityullapan vallavatallajebhya-
-stvaṃ pūtanāmātanuthāḥ sugandhim || 41-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: It was as if to send message to Gopas that the vision of Bhagwan will not be delayed. Eventually they will get Moksham in that birth itself. For this reason, Bhagwan conferred such a fragrance on Putana.

stanzas.sanskrit:
चित्रं पिशाच्या न हतः कुमार-
-श्चित्रं पुरैवाकथि शौरिणेदम् ।
इति प्रशंसन् किल गोपलोको
भवन्मुखालोकरसे न्यमाङ्क्षीत् ॥ ४१-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
citraṃ piśācyā na hataḥ kumāra-
-ścitraṃ puraivākathi śauriṇedam |
iti praśaṃsan kila gopaloko
bhavanmukhālokarase nyamāṅkṣīt || 41-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The Gopas were wonder struck that the boy was not killed by the demoness. They also marvelled at the events predicted by Vasudeva. Realising this, they were fully immersed in the joy of looking at Bhagwan’s  face.

stanzas.sanskrit:
दिने दिनेऽथ प्रतिवृद्धलक्ष्मी-
-रक्षीणमाङ्गल्यशतो व्रजोऽयम् ।
भवन्निवासादयि वासुदेव
प्रमोदसान्द्रः परितो विरेजे ॥ ४१-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
dine dine’tha prativṛddhalakṣmī-
-rakṣīṇamāṅgalyaśato vrajo’yam |
bhavannivāsādayi vāsudeva
pramodasāndraḥ parito vireje || 41-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Gokulam flourished day by day with prosperity, happiness, auspiciousness as Bhagwan himself was growing up there.

stanzas.sanskrit:
गृहेषु ते कोमलरूपहास-
-मिथः कथासङ्कुलिताः कमन्यः ।
वृत्तेषु कृत्येषु भवन्निरीक्षा-
-समागता प्रत्यहमत्यनन्दन् ॥ ४१-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gṛheṣu te komalarūpahāsa-
-mithaḥ kathāsaṅkulitāḥ kamanyaḥ |
vṛtteṣu kṛtyeṣu bhavannirīkṣā-
samāgatāḥ pratyahamatyanandan || 41-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas kept talking about the beauty of the child, his smile among themselves all day long while they did work and evenings they rushed to Nandagopan's house to see and play with the child.

stanzas.sanskrit:
अहो कुमारो मयि दत्तदृष्टिः
स्मितं कृतं मां प्रति वत्सकेन ।
एह्येहि मामित्युपसार्य पाणिं
त्वयीश किं किं न कृतं वधूभिः ॥ ४१-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
aho kumāro mayi dattadṛṣṭiḥ
smitaṃ kṛtaṃ māṃ prati vatsakena |
ehyehi māmityupasārya pāṇiṃ
tvayīśa kiṃ kiṃ na kṛtaṃ vadhūbhiḥ || 41-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopikas would call baby Krishna and stretched their arms to hold him in their arms and showered their love in many ways.
As each one of the Gopikas passed Krishna from one hand to the other, it was like honey beetle moving from one red lotus to the other in a garland.

stanzas.sanskrit:
निपाययन्ती स्तनमङ्कगं त्वां
विलोकयन्ती वदनं हसन्ती ।
दशां यशोदा कतमां न भेजे
स तादृशः पाहि हरे गदान्माम् ॥ ४१-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nipāyayantī stanamaṅkagaṃ tvāṃ
vilokayantī vadanaṃ hasantī |
daśāṃ yaśodā katamāṃ na bheje
sa tādṛśaḥ pāhi hare gadānmām || 41-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Yashoda fed the baby and kept looking at his face smilingly. Bhattathiri wondered at the joy, Yashoda must have experienced in all these acts of caring and pampering of Bhagwan Krishna. He requests Bhagwan to remove his ailments and save him.
stanzas.commentary_note: Stanza-scoped excerpt of caption #10; the trailing unrelated Madurāṣṭakam text remains preserved in intake/D041/photo-captions.txt and content/sources/d041/reference-map.json and is excluded from this stanza commentary.
